headline: Southern New Hampshire and American International set up rematch
dek: Southern New Hampshire beat Franklin Pierce and American International beat Bentley on Wednesday, each by a single goal. The two meet at Southern New Hampshire on Saturday; the hosts won September's meeting there and sit three points above American International in the conference table.
displaced_by: Wednesday's wins for Southern New Hampshire and American International, who now meet on Saturday

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-five goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have lost one match all season; American International are next to visit.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored seventeen of Franklin Pierce's thirty-five goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pace have conceded thirty-eight goals, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won eight matches and lost eight, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept eight clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: American International have now beaten Bentley home and away this season.

next_match.line: Southern New Hampshire's only defeat came at Adelphi in October; American International have won their last two.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
